description: No principal holds a GCP basic role (owner, editor, viewer) anywhere in the project unless it is a named allowance with a recorded reason

allowed.reason: The human account that created the project. The project sits outside any organization, so there is no org-level administrator above it; this is the only human with owner and the break-glass path for the project.

The provisioning identity. With projectIamAdmin it is owner-equivalent by necessity: declaring project IAM in Terraform requires the identity that applies it to be able to set project IAM (DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-22).

matrix_rows.gap: Two named allowances hold basic roles, each with a recorded reason: the account that created the project as owner, and terraform-admin as editor. The row as written allows none for an in-scope principal.
